why: RFC 0363: turning a share sheet's text + URL into the one line that goes
to the capture inbox has two implementations, and only because an iOS
share extension cannot load the Rust library:
Both test suites read THIS file, so a case answered differently on one
side fails there instead of reaching a user as a share that lost its
link. Add a case here, never to one suite alone.
`line: null` means 'nothing to save' — the caller says so rather than

cases.why: a link alone (sharing from a browser's address bar)
a link not already in the text is appended
a link already in the text is not repeated
a capture is one block, so newlines collapse
a title plus its link, which is what a browser shares
surrounding whitespace is trimmed off each line
an empty text with a link is the link
